s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement of the face
salient_findings: Progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement of the right side of the nose and right cheek
Slightly hyperplastic soft tissue with dilated patulous follicles
key_facts: 10-year history of progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement
Previous nondiagnostic skin biopsies
Underwent septorhinoplasty 6 months prior due to collapse of the right nasal ala
Significant submucosal tissue was noted and removed from the right nasal cavity during surgery
Initial improvement after surgery, followed by enlargement of soft tissue and thickening of the overlying skin
Clinical examination revealed hyperplastic soft tissue and dilated patulous follicles
Surgical pathology showed fibroadipose tissue and vascular proliferation
Initial skin biopsy was interpreted as sebaceous hyperplasia
Subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density
Thickened and fragmented collagen bundles
Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue

shortlist.label: Fibrolipomatous hamartoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement with hyperplastic soft tissue

shortlist.label: Nerve sheath myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Spindle cell proliferation with bland cytomorphology and absence of cellular pleomorphism

shortlist.label: Lipomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue and subcutaneous enlargement

shortlist.label: Fibrous hamartoma of infancy
shortlist.why_kept: Fibroadipose tissue and vascular proliferation with subcutaneous-based spindle cell proliferation

raw.rationale: The presence of subcutaneous-based proliferation of spindle cells with varying density, thickened and fragmented collagen bundles, and mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue are characteristic features of fibrolipomatous hamartoma, which explains the patient's 10-year history of progressive skin thickening and subcutaneous enlargement.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically presents with a more rapid growth rate and cellular pleomorphism, which is not observed in this case

rejected.label: Nerve sheath myxoma
rejected.why: Usually involves the nerve sheath and does not typically present with fibroadipose tissue and vascular proliferation

rejected.label: Lipomatosis
rejected.why: Involves the growth of mature adipocytes, but does not typically present with spindle cell proliferation or thickened collagen bundles

rejected.label: Fibrous hamartoma of infancy
rejected.why: Typically presents in infancy, which does not match the patient's age
